verdict.rationale: Navan is not an agent itself but a SaaS platform, and it publishes an official MCP server (developer.navan.com/mcp) documented via first-party docs and confirmed by an independent probe (llms.txt returning 200), enabling AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT to query Navan spend/travel data via natural language. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of actually using the MCP server beyond docs/probe confirmation.
